# Ryan Zannah

> Ryan Zannah is a web developer, designer and SEO specialist based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, with more than five years of experience (freelancing since 2021, graphic designer at the X-Brain Info Tech agency in Kushtia July to November 2023, at age 13). He is the founder of QORVAYN, a technology company founded on 10 March 2026 that builds Orbyn, GoalWear, eSkypixx and RYNEKA. He works remotely with clients worldwide speaks English natively and French at a professional working level.

## Products

- [Orbyn](https://ryanzannah.online/orbyn): A private space for long-distance couples, "Two places. One home." In beta at https://orbyn-drab.vercel.app, public launch planned in the coming months
- [GoalWear](https://ryanzannah.online/goalwear): Football jersey and streetwear e-commerce brand, live at https://goalwear.online
- [eSkypixx](https://ryanzannah.online/eskypixx): AI-powered visual and social platform for nature, sky and photography (planning phase)
- [RYNEKA](https://ryanzannah.online/ryneka): AI operating system to help people think, create and automate (planning phase)
